muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿اقرأ﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت).
﴿باسم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of the agent, i.e. "beginning" (مفتتحا); «اسم» is muḍāf.
﴿ربك﴾: the word ﴿رب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الذي﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب﴾, in the position of genitive.
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾, referring back to ﴿الذي﴾; the clause ﴿خلق﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾, referring back to ﴿الذي﴾; the clause ﴿خلق الإنسان﴾ is a badal (substitute) for the preceding ﴿خلق﴾, or verbal tawkīd (emphasis).
﴿الإنسان﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿من علق﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلق﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿اقرأ﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت); this «اقرأ» is an emphasis of the first ﴿اقرأ﴾.
﴿وربك﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), «رب» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الأكرم﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿اقرأ﴾ is resumptive for emphasis, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وربك الأكرم﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of ﴿اقرأ﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الأكرم﴾, or in the position of nominative as a second khabar (predicate) of ﴿ربك﴾.
﴿علم﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He" (هو), referring back to Allah, and its two objects are omitted, i.e. "He taught man writing by the pen" (علّم الإنسان الخطَّ بالقلم); the clause ﴿عَلَّم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿بالقلم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿علم﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿علم﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He" (هو), referring back to Allah.
﴿الإنسان﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa. The clause ﴿علّم الإنسان﴾ is an emphasis of the first ﴿علم﴾, or a badal (substitute), or a khabar (predicate).
﴿ما لم يعلم﴾: «ما» is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿لم يعلم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "he did not know it" (لم يعلمه).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿إن الإنسان﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, and «الإنسان» is its noun (ism).
﴿ليطغى﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «يطغى» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the agent's implied form is "he" (هو); the clause ﴿يطغى﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿أن﴾: a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; it together with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿رآه﴾: ﴿رآ﴾ is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿استغنى﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; the clause ﴿استغنى﴾ is the second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ refers back to man (الإنسان).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle.
﴿إلى ربك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿الرجعى﴾: the postponed noun (ism) of «إن»; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿أرأيت﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of wonder (taʿajjubī), and «رأى» is an indeclinable (mabnī) past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أرأيت﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ينهى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the agent is "he" (هو); the second object of ﴿رأيت﴾ is omitted, and it is an interrogative clause indicated by His saying ﴿ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى﴾; the clause ﴿ينهى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿عبدا﴾: the object of ﴿ينهى﴾.
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of future time, purely adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينهى﴾.
﴿صلى﴾: a past verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿أرأيت﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of wonder (taʿajjubī), and «رأى» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أرأيت﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كان﴾: a deficient past verb, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿على الهدى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; the clause ﴿إن كان على الهدى﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿أمر﴾: a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and its fāʿil (agent) is ﴿هو﴾; conjoined to ﴿كان على الهدى﴾.
﴿بالتقوى﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمر﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿أرأيت﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of wonder (taʿajjubī), and «رأى» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أرأيت﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كذب﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿وتولى﴾: conjoined to ﴿كذب﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (inkārī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm).
﴿بأن﴾: the bāʾ is for the genitive and «أن» is maṣdariyya.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, the noun (ism) of ﴿أن﴾.
﴿يرى﴾: an imperfect verb, and the agent is latent (mustatir); the clause of verb and agent is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن الله يرى﴾ is genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعلم﴾, and the clause ﴿ألم يعلم﴾ is in the position of accusative as the second object of the first ﴿رأيت﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿كلا﴾: deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لئن﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and «إن» is conditional.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive.
﴿ينته﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter.
﴿لنسفعا﴾: the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and «نسفعا» is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the light nūn of emphasis, which is written with an alif in the Muṣḥaf according to the rule of pausing; the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "We" (نحن); the verbal clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the answer of the oath indicates it and fulfils its meaning.
﴿بالناصية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نسفعا﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿ناصية﴾: a badal (substitute) for ﴿الناصية﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿كاذبة خاطئة﴾: two naʿts (adjectives) of ﴿ناصية﴾, genitive.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فليدع﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), the lām is the lām of command, and «يدع» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the wāw, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "he" (هو).
﴿ناديه﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿سندع﴾: the sīn is a particle of the future, and «ندعو» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the wāw, which was dropped for lightness, and the agent is ﴿نحن﴾.
﴿الزبانية﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿كلا﴾: an emphasis of the deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لا﴾: prohibitive, governing the jussive.
﴿تطعه﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: "you" (أنت), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿واسجد﴾: an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
﴿واقترب﴾: conjoined to ﴿واسجد﴾.
